title: Separate observe, prepare, and execute tool classes
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He runs `tool_phase_guard`: observe/prepare contracts cannot register write or external effects; execute may. An alias cannot smuggle a weaker phase. Lifecycle observe hooks exist (`fangore_insp_lifecycle_observe`) but are not a tool-class taxonomy. Tracks MH-DOTS-03[^insp-dots-03].
implementation: `OperationRegistry.register` + `OperationContract` / `ToolPhase` via product verb `tool_phase_guard` (`cli_policy_verbs`). Walk-bag `in`/`out` carry contracts and register/refuse lists.
validation: Harness `user_story` walks `tool_phase_guard`; expects registered / refused / alias_supported.
